info.title: OMDb Universal API
info.description: Search movies, series, and episodes by title or IMDb ID

get.description: Retrieves an episode from OMDb by series IMDb ID, season, and episode.

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

parameters.name: imdbId
parameters.description: Series IMDb ID to use for the episode lookup.

schema.description: Series IMDb ID to use for the episode lookup.

parameters.name: season
parameters.description: Season number that contains the episode.

parameters.description: Episode number within the season.

schema.description: Episode number within the season.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated response fields to include.

403.description: The API key or connection cannot access this action.
